title: How Much Does a Website Cost? Builders, WordPress and Stores
h1: How much does a website cost to build? Wix, WordPress, Shopify and more
description: Starting prices for Wix, WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace and WooCommerce sites from sellers we feature, and what pushes a website project above the entry price.
intro: A website can cost a few hundred dollars or many thousands, depending on what it has to do. This article gives real starting prices from the website sellers we feature and explains what moves a project from a simple site to a larger build, so you can set a realistic budget before you ask for quotes.

faq.q: What is the cheapest way to get a professional website?
faq.a: A template-based site on a builder such as Wix or Squarespace, built by a freelancer who customizes the design and sets up your pages.

faq.q: Do the starting prices include hosting and a domain?
faq.a: Usually not. Hosting, a domain name and any paid builder plan are separate costs that you pay to the provider.

faq.q: Why is an online store more expensive than a brochure site?
faq.a: A store needs product setup, payments, shipping and tax settings, and more testing than a site that only presents information.

faq.q: Is a custom-coded site worth the extra cost?
faq.a: Only if you need features that a builder or plugin cannot provide. Many small businesses are well served by a builder or WordPress.
Yes. Updates, backups and small changes continue after launch, and are cheaper when planned for from the start.
